title: 第174章 范理：你这人，眼光倒是挺毒辣的
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

小k连连点头道，“这店必须拍。飞哥，要不你去问问老板”

大飞站起身，快步走到开放式厨房的台面前，脸上立刻堆起职业笑容。

“老板，忙着呢？”

范理抬头瞥了大飞一眼，“吃好了？”

大飞清了清嗓子，身体微微前倾，“正式认识一下，我是咱们同城的探店博主大飞，粉丝老多了。老板，你这手艺太棒了！我想给你这店免费拍一期探店视频，不要钱！”

范理放下菜刀，拿过一旁的毛巾擦了擦手。

“探店视频？”

“对！”大飞狂点头，满脸期待。

“不拍。”

范理果断转身，走到水槽边开始洗抹布，“我现在不需要什么探店。”

大飞愣在原地。他干这行三年了，探过大小馆子上百家，只要说出免费帮拍，哪个老板不是乐得合不拢嘴，赶紧端茶倒水？今天竟然吃了个闭门羹。

“老板，你别误会啊。”

大飞急了，“我真的一分钱不要。我这视频只要发出去，保准你明天客流量翻倍！”

听到客流量翻倍五个字，范理洗抹布的手猛地停住。

开什么玩笑。

现在一天干四个小时，他的手腕都快抡冒烟了。这要是客流量翻倍，他还能准时在下午六点下班吗？他还怎么去谢老板的水汇按脚？晚上还能不能好好打游戏了？

绝对不行。

“真不用。”

范理摆摆手，语气坚定道，“我这店面小，客人已经够多了。你拍了也是浪费素材，慢走不送啊。”

大飞彻底傻眼。这老板是跟钱有仇吗？

他脑子飞速运转，目光在范理身上扫了两圈。这年轻人看着懒散，但骨子里透着股自信，来硬的肯定不行。

大飞深吸了一口气，突然压低声音，语气变得极其诚恳，“老板，实不相瞒。我想拍你，不光是因为你这面好吃。”

范理偏过头疑惑道，“那因为什么？”

“主要是你这长相。”

大飞指了指范理的脸，表情严肃道，“你这骨相，这气质！刚才你在灶台前颠勺那一瞬间，有一种历经沧桑却不改初心的破碎感！粉丝现在就爱看你这种帅得掉渣的厨子！”

一旁的小K赶紧配合着疯狂点头。

范理站在水槽边，没说话。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Little K nodded repeatedly and said, "This store must be photographed. Brother Fei, why don't you ask the boss?"

Da Fei stood up and walked quickly to the open kitchen counter, with a professional smile on his face.

"Boss, are you busy?"

Fan Li raised his head and glanced at Da Fei, "Have you eaten yet?"

Da Fei cleared his throat and leaned forward slightly, "Let me meet you formally. I am Da Fei, a store exploration blogger from our city. I have a lot of fans. Boss, your skills are great! I want to shoot a store exploration video for your store for free, for free!"

Fan Li put down the kitchen knife, took the towel aside and wiped his hands.

"Store tour video?"

"Yes!" Da Fei nodded wildly, looking forward to it.

"No shooting."

Fan Li turned around decisively, walked to the sink and started washing the rag, "I don't need any shop visits now."

Da Fei froze on the spot.He has been in this business for three years and has visited hundreds of restaurants, big and small. As long as he is told to help with shooting for free, which boss would not be so happy that he would smile from ear to ear and rush to bring tea and water?Today I got a rejection.

"Boss, don't get me wrong."

Da Fei was anxious, "I really don't want a penny. As long as I send out this video, I guarantee that your customer traffic will double tomorrow!"

Hearing the words "double passenger flow", Fan Li's hand washing the rag stopped suddenly.

What a joke.

Now that he works four hours a day, his wrists are almost smoking.If the passenger volume doubles, can he still get off work at 6pm on time?How else could he go to Boss Xie's Shuihui to have his feet pressed?Can you still play games at night?

Absolutely not.

"No need."

Fan Li waved his hand and said firmly, "My store is small and there are already enough customers. If you take pictures, it will be a waste of material. You can't send it away if you leave."

Da Fei was completely dumbfounded.Does this boss have a grudge against money?

His mind was running rapidly, and his eyes swept around Fan Li twice.This young man looks lazy, but there is confidence in his bones, and he will definitely not be able to do it hard.

Da Fei took a deep breath, suddenly lowered his voice, and his tone became extremely sincere, "Boss, I'm telling you the truth. I want to take pictures of you, not just because your noodles are delicious."

Fan Li turned his head and asked in confusion, "Then why?"

"Mainly because of your looks."

Da Fei pointed at Fan Li's face and said with a serious expression, "Your appearance and temperament! The moment you tossed the spoon in front of the stove just now, there was a sense of brokenness that has gone through many vicissitudes but has not changed its original intention! Fans now love to see such a handsome cook like you!"

Little K on the side quickly nodded in agreement.

Fan Li stood by the sink and said nothing.
